notes: OUT-OF-SCOPE indicator. mrv=4&gapfill=Y returns calendar years 2025-2022 with nulls replaced by carried-forward older values (e.g. JPN 2022-2024 = 32.3, which is really the 2020 value; MEX 2025 = 42.6 copied from 2024). obs_status stays empty, so fabricated values are indistinguishable.
